numberFormat.note: Closed 8-digit plan (AB PQ MC DU) in force since 1 January 2011 per the ARE communication published by the ITU (30.VI.2010); the annex lists mobile ranges starting 2 (Chinguitel), 3 (Mattel) and 4 (Mauritel), but the FR/EN tables are not fully consistent. ARE 2025-2026 interconnection catalogues still use +222 + 8 digits. Not fetched (network blocked); search results only.

country.notes: Constitution of 1991 (revised 2017), article 6: Arabic is the official language; Arabic, Pulaar, Soninké and Wolof are national languages. 'fr' is listed for the store because French is widely used in business and on bank/operator sites, but it is NOT an official language (no official source for its usage). Currency: ouguiya, code MRU since the 1 January 2018 redenomination (replaced MRO), issued by the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie.
